# Overture Systems Solutions - Enterprise AI Solutions for Business Intelligence, Strategy, Implementation, and Compliance

> **Overture Systems Solutions** specializes in **AI-driven business intelligence solutions** for **Fortune 500 enterprises** and innovative organizations. Our offerings include **strategic AI consulting**, **HIPAA-compliant B2B research platforms** for healthcare and non-profits, the **Uterpi AI platform** for workflow automation and collaboration, and **SOC 2 Type II certified security**. We deliver **3.5x average ROI within 18 months**, **60% operational time savings**, **95% project success rates**, and transformations for **over 200 clients** across industries like healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, technology, and non-profits.

## About

- [Company Overview](https://new-oss.vercel.app/about.md): Mission to revolutionize business intelligence through AI, with free consultations, AI assistant support for navigation, and focus on rapid deployment, business-aligned tech, enterprise security, and proven results.

## Core Services

- [AI Strategy & Implementation](https://new-oss.vercel.app/consulting.md): Comprehensive consulting including strategy & roadmap (planning, ROI analysis, risk evaluation), implementation (POC to production, integration, optimization), operations (model tuning, maintenance), training (workshops, mentorship), governance & ethics (policies, assessments), and analytics (predictive insights, BI). Process: Discovery (1-2 weeks), Planning (2-3 weeks), Implementation (8-16 weeks), Optimization (ongoing). Benefits: 3.5x ROI, 60% time savings, 95% success.
- [B2B Research Platform](https://new-oss.vercel.app/research.md): HIPAA-compliant AI for healthcare (market analysis, partnerships, clinical trials, payer landscapes) and non-profits (grants, donors, impact measurement). Features: AI-powered insights, intelligent research, predictive analytics, data integration, real-time updates. Impacts: 80% time savings, 95% accuracy, 70% cost reduction, revenue growth; served 500+ orgs, 10M+ data points. Process: Define criteria, AI analysis, action on insights.

## Platforms

- [Uterpi AI Platform](https://uterpi.com/uterpi.md): Modern AI solution for streamlining workflows, automating processes, enhancing productivity with advanced models, team collaboration, and SOC 2 compliance. Enterprise features for scalable, secure AI deployments.

## Compliance and Security

- [Enterprise Compliance Details](https://new-oss.vercel.app/compliance.md): Certifications include SOC 2 Type II (annual audits, continuous monitoring, AES-256 encryption, TLS 1.3, RBAC, real-time threat detection); HIPAA (PHI encryption, access controls, BAA, valid 2025); GDPR (privacy-by-design, data portability, consent); ISO 27001 (risk assessment, incident response, valid 2024); CCPA (opt-out, consumer requests); FedRAMP-ready (government standards); PCI DSS Level 1 (valid 2025). Additional practices: MFA, redundancy, audits, penetration testing. Process: Assessment (1 week), Planning (1-2 weeks), Deployment (4-8 weeks), Continuous (ongoing).
